newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Smart to raise 1.7 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Smart to raise 1.7 bln pesos.

text.p: Philippines' Smart Communications Inc said on Tuesday it would raise 1.7 billion pesos by issuing convertible bonds.
The funds will partly finance an expansion programme for both its fixed and mobile telecom networks, the company said in a statement.

The convertible bonds will be issued to existing shareholders -- First Pacific Co Ltd, its Philippine flagship firm Metro Pacific Corp, Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, and a group of Filipino investors.
Smart, the country's biggest cellular phone company, has earmarked 15 billion pesos for a two-year expansion programme.
The company had initially scheduled a public shares offering by the middle of the year, but decided to defer it to a latter date due to the volatile conditions in the local and international markets.
Details of the bond issue were not disclosed.
Smart plans to install landlines, set up new mobile telephone switches, and increase the number of its cellular base stations.
